name: workflow-opportunity-auditor
description: Audit a business workflow, research existing solutions, and produce an evidence-backed build-versus-reuse decision.

interface.shortDescription: Decide what to automate and what to reuse first.
interface.longDescription: Maps a business workflow, calculates an honest baseline from supplied inputs, researches existing products and open-source options, and produces a supervised build-versus-reuse decision with a reversible experiment and kill criteria.
defaultPrompt: Audit a repetitive workflow before I automate it.
Research whether this workflow already has a tool.
